sources.title: Commission AI system definition guidance publication
sources.reading_status: Adopted PDF C(2025) 5053 final, 29 July 2025, read in English. Publication page initially dated 6 February 2025; PDF identity takes precedence for the retained adopted version.

sources.title: Draft classification guidance publication
sources.reading_status: Three draft parts retained; general framework and selected product, gateway and justice examples read. Not a complete example-by-example reading. Lessons use the amended statute for operative tests; no draft example is treated as a binding permission.

sources.title: Commission prohibited-practices guidance, 2025
sources.reading_status: Retained; selected criminal-risk and emotion sections read. Not a full guideline audit. Lessons teach the operative Article 5 elements from the consolidated statute and do not infer borderline permission from unread guideline examples. Predates the 2026 additions.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.reading_status: Article 4(4) profiling definition checked through official EU material; Article 5 AI Act preservation of GDPR Article 9 read. No lesson claims a complete GDPR lawful-basis assessment.

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2016/680
sources.reading_status: Article 3(4) profiling definition read in official text; no national law-enforcement permission is inferred.

sources.title: Directive 2011/93/EU
sources.reading_status: Article 2(a), (c), (e) read in official text. National without-right defence left unresolved because cases specify no jurisdiction; no exception is invented.

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2022/2557
sources.reading_status: Article 2(4) critical-infrastructure definition and related essential-service definition read in official text.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230
sources.reading_status: Annex I Section B placement and amended Article 2/6 read. Sector-law scope and assessment route are supplied as explicit fictional case assumptions; no actual machinery category is assigned.

sources.title: Guidelines on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of AI systems
sources.reading_status: Publication page checked; retained PDF identity and selected paragraphs 11-14, 25-31, 111-116 read. Full reading pending; predates the 27 July 2026 amendment.

sources.title: Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-generated Content
sources.reading_status: Official publication and policy pages read; final publication date, two-section structure and adequacy confirmation checked. Full Code and adequacy assessment not yet read.

sources.title: Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/745
sources.reading_status: Annex I identity read. Cases explicitly stipulate sector coverage and assessment requirements to exercise Article 6; actual medical-device category and sector compliance are not determined.

sources.title: Personal Protective Equipment Regulation (EU) 2016/425
sources.reading_status: Annex I identity read. Cases explicitly stipulate sector coverage and assessment requirements to exercise Article 6; actual PPE category and sector compliance are not determined.
